title: EmbodimentDescriptor
description: Structured description of a specific physical robot configuration (embodiment) against which a skill or VLA model is being tested. Used by the Robot Skill Acceptance Lab (RESET XIX, 2026-08-20).

embodimentId.description: Unique identifier for this specific embodiment configuration.

controllerFirmwareVersion.description: Firmware/software version of the robot controller.

joints.description: Number of degrees of freedom / joints.

gripper.description: Gripper or end-effector model, e.g. 'Robotiq 2F-85', 'OnRobot RG2'.

sensors.description: Sensor hardware present, e.g. ['Intel RealSense D435', 'Robotiq FT 300'].

compute.description: Onboard or edge compute platform, e.g. 'Jetson Orin NX 16GB', 'NVIDIA RTX 4090'.

computeDriverVersion.description: Driver or CUDA version relevant to skill execution.

safetyControllerModel.description: Safety PLC or safety controller, e.g. 'SICK flexi soft', 'Pilz PSS 4000'.

speedLimitPercent.description: Speed limit applied as percentage of maximum rated speed.

surfaceType.description: Surface material the task involves, e.g. 'cardboard', 'plastic-bag', 'metal-part'.

installationDate.description: Date this embodiment configuration was assembled/calibrated for testing.

labFacility.description: Name or identifier of the physical facility where this embodiment is located.
